meta.name: og-ds01-rev00-cd-meas
meta.notes:
REV00 as drawn, C_d 0.673 from the measured hole. Nozzle data from Mistelix DS-01 Rev 1 (MTX-WMS-NOZ-DS-001, 2026-09-21), at its 65 bar design point. THE SHEET STATES NOTHING IS MEASURED: K, D32, cone angle and velocity are all ESTIMATED, and it says plainly that 'Nothing in this document constitutes a validated or certified product rating.' The single measured datum in the whole project is a drilled test hole, 16.2 L/min at 100 bar. Measured values are to come from TEST-001/002/003/018.

NOT MODELLED: the sheet's intended installation is WALL-MOUNTED at 4.6 m, 35 degrees below horizontal (Table 5-1). This design keeps the ceiling-row mounting because the schema has one tilt scalar shared by every row, so two walls tilting inward cannot be expressed. What this run varies is the nozzle's hydraulics and spray, not its installation geometry.

ACTIVATION: zones.activation_delay_s set to 180 s after detection (was 60 s, inherited from the Rev 0 file). Every full-scale test on record waited about three minutes: the 2020 San Pedro de Anes lab report sets a minimum 3 min delay and attributes it to pump start and pressure rise (measured 193-211 s), and the 2025 300 MW test activated 3 min after its 60 C alarm (181 s). Annex 7 5.2.8 requires manual activation delayed relative to detection, and 3.2 requires the real tunnel to detect and activate at least as fast as the test did.

constraints.note: Site and procurement limits. NOT from SOLIT2 and not acceptance criteria.

ahj.note: Only one acceptance limit is set, because only one is stated by an authority. HPWM-TECHNICAL SPEC_R2 section 6 requires a 150 MW minimum design fire load reduced to <= 50 MW. Every other Annex 7 criterion stays null and is reported 'unset': the tender defers tenability to 'SOLIT2 or NFPA 502 test protocols' without naming numbers, and Annex 7 7.1 leaves those to the authority having jurisdiction. Do not fill them from a vendor's test report -- see INDEPENDENCE.md rule 2.
